about_the_game:
Strike back in style against the ferocious Naytiba with new must-have cosmetic costumes in this add-on expansion for Stellar Blade™.

Prepare EVE for her latest heroic adventure with an eye-catching black and gold Planet Diving Suit (Captain), and give your Drone a new cute-but-deadly aesthetic with the custom Fluffy Bear Pack.*

Saving the world never looked so good!

*Game purchase required to access downloadable content.

content_descriptors.notes: Stellar Blade™ is an action-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players engage in fast paced melee-style combat with weapons such as blades, machine guns and laser blasters. Attacks result in black splatter effects, and can also impale, dismember, or decapitate the enemies. There are female characters in revealing costumes. There are some references to suicide and torture. There are scenes which include depictions of alcohol and tobacco. Low-mid level language is used in the dialogue.
